sources.observation: Opcode 49 enables banking and does not open a separate amount-transfer workspace.
Opening Swap while banking is available moves all banked gold, gems, and jewelry into the shared pool; transfers use five gold or one gem or jewelry; Done performs no bank mutation.
Forward location departure returns every remaining pooled denomination to the bank and disables banking.
Location cleanup also returns the complete pool to the bank and disables banking.

expectedTrace: move all banked denominations to the pool once
perform Pool, Share, or exact character transfers
return the remaining pool to the bank on location departure
